title: __str__ vs __repr__
Property Without Setter Raises on Assignment

bugs.explanation: The `radius` property has no setter, making it read-only. Assigning `c.radius = 10` raises `AttributeError: can't set attribute`. Either remove the assignment or add a `@radius.setter` method that validates and sets `self._r`.

title: __eq__ Without __hash__

bugs.explanation: When you define `__eq__`, Python sets `__hash__` to `None`, making instances unhashable — they cannot be stored in sets or used as dict keys. Define `__hash__` alongside `__eq__` to keep the object hashable: `return hash(self.name)`.

title: Class Variable vs Instance Variable
code:
class Robot:
    count = 0
    def __init__(self):
        Robot.count += 1

r1 = Robot()
r2 = Robot()
print(Robot.count)

title: Inheriting __init__ Without Calling super

bugs.explanation: `Car.__init__` overrides `Vehicle.__init__` but never calls `super().__init__(speed)`. As a result `self.speed` is never set and accessing `c.speed` raises `AttributeError`. Always call `super().__init__(...)` to initialise the parent class.

title: dataclass Auto-generates __init__
code:
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Point:
    x: float
    y: float

p = Point(1.0, 2.0)
print(p.x, p.y)

title: Accessing Private Attribute From Outside

bugs.explanation: Python name-mangles attributes with double underscores: `__balance` becomes `_Wallet__balance`. Accessing `w.__balance` directly raises `AttributeError`. Use the mangled name `w._Wallet__balance` or add a public accessor method.

title: __len__ Required for len()

bugs.explanation: `len(b)` calls `b.__len__()`. Since `Bag` has no `__len__` method, Python raises `TypeError: object of type 'Bag' has no len()`. Define `__len__` to delegate to `self.items`.

title: Multiple Inheritance Method Resolution
Abstract Method Not Implemented

bugs.explanation: `Square` inherits from `Shape` but does not implement the `@abstractmethod area()`. Instantiating `Square` raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class Square`. Implement `area()` in `Square`.

title: __iter__ and __next__ Protocol
Overriding __add__

bugs.explanation: `__add__` implements the `+` operator, but the body subtracts instead of adds (`self.x - other.x`). Change `-` to `+` in both components.

title: Context Manager __enter__ Return Value

bugs.explanation: `__enter__` returns `None` implicitly, so `m` in the `with` block is `None`. If you want `m` to be the managed object itself, return `self` from `__enter__`.

title: Slots to Restrict Attributes
code:
class Point:
    __slots__ = ('x', 'y')
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

p = Point(1, 2)
p.z = 3

bugs.explanation: When a class uses `__slots__`, only the declared attributes (`x` and `y`) are allowed. Assigning `p.z = 3` raises `AttributeError: 'Point' object has no attribute 'z'`. Either add `'z'` to `__slots__` or remove the `__slots__` declaration.
